sentences.text: This leatherback's tag first reported on {first_date} and kept reporting for {days_tracked}.
Leatherbacks are the largest living turtles.
Over that time it ended up {max_displacement_km} from where its track began, {species_rank_distance}.
Its positions range from {northernmost_lat} down to {southernmost_lat}, just south of the equator.
It reached its farthest point on {farthest_date}.
The last position came on {last_date}. Where the turtle went after that isn't recorded.
